name: ente-doctor-backend
description: Ente Doctor healthcare platform backend monorepo.

scripts.db:migrate: docker compose up flyway-auth flyway-provider flyway-booking flyway-search flyway-notification
scripts.db:info: docker compose run --rm flyway-auth info && docker compose run --rm flyway-booking info
scripts.db:repair: docker compose run --rm flyway-auth repair && docker compose run --rm flyway-provider repair && docker compose run --rm flyway-booking repair && docker compose run --rm flyway-search repair && docker compose run --rm flyway-notification repair
